fields.source: Original master recording:  Sony ECM-959 stereo mic in painter’s cap, very FOB, center, on the floor -> Denon DTR-80P (master @16 bit/48khz)  DAT Transfer: Sony R-500 -> Sound Devices 722 digital input (@24/48khz)  Mastering:  Spectralayers 11 for painstaking manual scrubbing of thousands of yells, whistles, conversations, howls, yelps, laughs, etc @ 32 bit float/48khz.  Then to Adobe Audition 25.3.0.71 for EQ and fixing hundreds of small +/- 2-5db volume differences between the L/R channels due to the mic being loose in my hat — all at 32 bit float/48khz.  24 to 16 bit dithering done in Adobe Audition 2025. Tracked in CDWav 1.98.  Flac files tagged using Tag&Rename 3.9.15.
